decisions.reason: Product A is close to the firm's established heat exchange equipment and benefits from strong absorptive capacity through in-house R&D and university cooperation, making improvement more likely than withdrawal.

Although similar to the dropped Product B, Product C still builds closely on existing condenser technology and the firm's related knowledge supports learning, so a drop is unlikely but slightly less certain.
The tube liner directly leverages the firm's established service and repair expertise, giving high absorptive capacity to evaluate and improve it, so it is likely to be kept.
Customized industrial air coolers extend the firm's core cooling offer, and the firm can use its existing knowledge and customer feedback to refine the product line, supporting a keep decision.
Tube end repair inserts build on the firm's maintenance capabilities and related knowledge, enabling effective learning and a low probability of withdrawal.
